summary: Workspace seam + Bash/Read/Write/Edit tools, spill-to-file, run transcripts, provider-neutral reasoning round-trip, loop context clearing, run timeouts, a delegate tool over sub-agent rosters, and live tool events (current_tool_call).
why: First consumer (throu) moved to one agent with a per-user sandbox; these are the generic primitives it needed.

summary: shankit.testing.ScriptedModel: a scriptable fake model client (text, tool calls, reasoning, structured output, usage, errors, raw blocks) with request snapshots, per-turn expect checks, and loud ScriptFailure on script mismatches.
why: throu's test-infrastructure plan needs deterministic, zero-spend model behavior for unit tests; this promotes the suite's FakeModel pattern to public API.

summary: Browser-driving primitives: multimodal tool results (text/image/provider blocks), native toolsets with toolset_name round-trip on Anthropic, ordered fail-stop batches, image-aware context clearing, emitted artifacts in RunResult; multimodal results capped cumulatively.
why: throu gives its assistant a background browser agent on Anthropic browser_toolset_20260801; each piece is generic so other consumers get screenshots and native toolsets too.

summary: WorkspaceTools Read returns an image (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, found by its bytes, up to 3.75 MB) as an ImageBlock instead of refusing it as binary; the step reads 'Looked at <name>'.
why: throu's assistant draws fallback charts as PNGs and had no way to look at them (a clipped chart reached a beta tester), nor at photos users attach.

summary: Instructions and ModelRequest.system take the system prompt in parts (a list, stable to volatile): Anthropic sends one cacheable text block per part, OpenAI joins them.
why: throu's layered assistant prompt caches its shared and per-user layers separately without smuggling a marker through a plain string.

summary: AnthropicModel checks each Claude model's request rules (model_rules): reasoning off sends the model's lowest setting (between_tools on Sonnet 5.5, low effort on Opus 5.5/Fable), forced tool_choice, budget_tokens and temperature fall back where a model rejects them.
why: Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 400 on thinking-disabled and forced tool_choice, so throu couldn't move to them with the same requests.
